∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing.{u_1} R] [Nontrivial.{u_1} R] (p : Polynomial.{u_1} R),
  Polynomial.Monic.{u_1} p →
    Eq.{u_1 + 1} (Matrix.charpoly.{u_1, 0} (Etingof.Proposition5_2_3.companionMatrix.{u_1} p)) p

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing.{u_1} R] [Nontrivial.{u_1} R] {S : Type u_2} [inst_2 : CommRing.{u_2} S]
  (φ : RingHom.{u_1, u_2} R S) (p : Polynomial.{u_1} R),
  Polynomial.Monic.{u_1} p →
    ∀ (z : S),
      Eq.{u_2 + 1} (Polynomial.eval₂.{u_1, u_2} φ z p) 0 →
        Polynomial.IsRoot.{u_2}
          (Matrix.charpoly.{u_2, 0}
            (Matrix.map.{u_1, u_2, 0, 0} (Etingof.Proposition5_2_3.companionMatrix.{u_1} p)
              (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} φ)))
          z

  [inst : CommRing.{u_1} R] →

∀ (z : Complex) (p : Polynomial.{0} Rat),
  Polynomial.Monic.{0} p →
    Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Polynomial.aeval.{0, 0} z) p) 0 →
      Polynomial.IsRoot.{0}
        (Matrix.charpoly.{0, 0}
          (Matrix.map.{0, 0, 0, 0} (Etingof.Proposition5_2_3.companionMatrix.{0} p)
            (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Algebra.algebraMap.{0, 0} Rat Complex))))
        z

∀ (z : Complex) (p : Polynomial.{0} Int),
  Polynomial.Monic.{0} p →
    Eq.{1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Polynomial.aeval.{0, 0} z) p) 0 →
      Polynomial.IsRoot.{0}
        (Matrix.charpoly.{0, 0}
          (Matrix.map.{0, 0, 0, 0} (Etingof.Proposition5_2_3.companionMatrix.{0} p)
            (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Algebra.algebraMap.{0, 0} Int Complex))))
        z
